gitCommit.subject: Settings, MCP server: the card says any agent can be targeted, that no port is opened, and the cap the server applies (#480) (#521)
gitCommit.body:
Settings, MCP server: the card says any agent can be targeted, that no port is opened, and the cap the server applies (#480) (#521)

* Settings, MCP server: the card says any agent can be targeted, that no port is opened, and the cap the server applies (#480)

"Hand work to this workspace's root agent" was false: run_task takes an
`agent` slug, the root is only the default. "External" read as "from outside
the network" for a stdio server that opens no port. The cap was not
mentioned. The number the card shows is MCP_MAX_JOBS_IN_FLIGHT, now in
@nodal-agents/shared and read by the server too, so the screen cannot say
another number than the one enforced. No em dash.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UxGj8qz7SoCeWh1q1inSKE

* Runs: an MCP run shows the label its caller gave, as the Settings card says (review of PR #521)

The MCP server stores `caller` "to make 'who asked for this?' readable in the
Runs page", and the card promised it, but originOfRun mapped every MCP run to
"MCP" with no detail: the label was never shown. It is now read the way an
automation's name and a webhook's name already are. Tests: the origin with and
without a caller; the card's Runs and configuration-tools sentences; and the
server's DEFAULT cap equals the shared constant the card shows.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UxGj8qz7SoCeWh1q1inSKE

* Settings, MCP server: the enable confirmation says any agent can be targeted too, not "your root agent" (review of PR #521, pass 2)

The dialog shown when the owner switches MCP on still said every process
could hand work "to your root agent", a false security statement at the
moment of enabling. It now says the same as the card, without em dashes, and
a test opens the dialog and reads it.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UxGj8qz7SoCeWh1q1inSKE

---------
